request.summary: Audit the six most-used observed skills one by one for efficiency without removing controls that contain demonstrated hazards.
request.intent: Produce verified exact maintenance change requests and a one-change-at-a-time queue.

execution.notes: The review produced ten independent maintenance requests. No canonical skill mutation was authorized or performed.

anti_pattern_hits: usage or gap counts could be mistaken for failure counts
blind regeneration could erase legitimate local overlays
human confirmation could be repeated without a machine-consumed receipt

workflow_gaps.summary: Declared Subagents invariants are not all enforced by the registration appender.
workflow_gaps.evidence: Current appender can record RESERVED dispatches and orphan closes and does not enforce working-agent versus final-approver separation.

workflow_gaps.summary: The Inventory machine index is parseable but fails its current kind contract.
workflow_gaps.evidence: Current validator exits non-zero on exactly 15 out-of-enum records.

workflow_gaps.summary: Generated skill surfaces mix stale copies and legitimate local overlays without declared composition.
workflow_gaps.evidence: Subagents owner and installed copies differ substantively; Whisper .claude lacks current controls while .agents carries multiple local presets.

useful_patterns: opposed efficiency and containment attackers converged after direct confrontation
verifier removed unsupported overbreadth instead of softening it
one human delegation confirmation remains where it grants real authority
observer.recommendation: Run the accepted maintenance queue one bounded change request at a time, beginning with DSS-1.
